title: SharedSectionWriteResponse
description: The result of a shared workflow record write.

credentialingDisplayGroupKey.description: The record's identity after the write: the value the next write takes as {deduplicationId}.

deduplicationId.description: Deprecated: the same value as credentialingDisplayGroupKey, which replaces it. Read credentialingDisplayGroupKey; this field will be removed.

outcomes.description: One entry per affected tenant the caller can read.

hiddenTenantCount.description: Tenants this write reached or skipped that the caller cannot read. Not the Sections GET's hiddenTenantCount, which counts every participating tenant the caller cannot read.

attachment.description: An attachment add only: the file it stored, once, for every copy it reached. Absent from every other write's response.

SharedSectionWriteAttachment.description: The file an attachment add stored.

fileUrl.description: The stored file's storage key, which every copy it reached holds and an attachment remove takes: fetch it through a signed URL, never use it as a link.
